title.narrative: Productive Development and Creative Economy Support Program
Programa de Apoyo al Desarrollo Productivo y la Economa Creativa

description.narrative: El objetivo general de esta serie programtica y su primera operacin es contribuir a mejorar la productividad de la economa colombiana a travs de medidas que promueven el desarrollo del sector productivo y su diversificacin. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mantener un entorno macroeconmico estable; (ii) fortalecer el marco institucional y de polticas pblicas que impulsan la innovacin, la productividad a nivel empresarial y el emprendimiento; y (iii) proveer un marco institucional y regulatorio favorable al desarrollo de la economa creativa.

The objective of this programmatic series and its first operation is to contribute to improve Colombian economy with measures that promote its productive sector development and its diversification. The specific objectives are: (i) to maintain a stable macroeconomic environment; (ii) to strengthen the institutional framework and public policies that drive innovation, business productivity and entrepreneurship; and (iii) to provide an institutional and regulatory framework for the development of the creative economy.
